name: RISTIKLAPPI
description: Ristiklappi (Ristikontra variant) is a Finnish Sedma-group game for 4 in partnerships. Tricks won by last card of same rank as led. 5 cards each; stock. Point cards: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2. 'Clean' rule: if team took a queen before stock empty, must later win a trick with a king (not won by queen) to clean. First to 7 game points wins.

content.text: Ristiklappi (Ristikontra variant) is a Finnish Sedma-group game for 4 in partnerships. Tricks won by last card of same rank as led. 5 cards each; stock. Point cards: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2. 'Clean' rule: if team took a queen before stock empty, must later win a trick with a king (not won by queen) to clean. First to 7 game points wins.

Ristiklappi originates in northern Finland and Lapland as a more elaborate variant of Ristikontra within the Sedma group of games, in which tricks are won by the last card of the same rank as led. The Sedma family is confined to a region from Lapland to Hungary. The game was popular in lumber camps and is documented as a Finnish point-trick game with the distinctive clean rule (queen-taking requiring a later king-trick).
